headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when DOUKI went straight to headlining on debut against Jack Perry, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.43 ? a solid showing. Battling Jack Perry in a preview of Sunday's IWGP title match, DOUKI put Perry through a table with a top-rope senton before ultimately falling to Perry's borrowed Skull End submission.

On a Friday in 2023, back when YOH arrived in AEW against Cobb, Fletcher & Ospreay vs. CHAOS vs. Best Friends vs. Kyle Fletcher vs. Will Ospreay vs. Jeff Cobb vs. Swerve Strickland vs. Chuck Taylor vs. Trent Beretta vs. Rocky Romero, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.89.
